_instructions: Given the task text, the system must decide: 'slot_filling' or 'explanation'.
slot_filling  -> the assistant must COLLECT structured data from the user.
Also when it combines information + collecting a preference.
explanation   -> the assistant must EXPLAIN something and check comprehension.
ONLY when there is NOTHING to collect.
task            : task text as it would reach the DialogManager
notes           : why this case is hard or interesting
